jobs_results.title: Desarrollador de .NET
jobs_results.description:
¿Estás buscando una oportunidad emocionante y desafiante en cliente final?¿Quieres dar un impulso a tu carrera y formar parte de una empresa en fuerte crecimiento?

Empresa del mundo del transporte, caracterizada por:

· Proyectos comprometidos con la innovación y excelencia.

· Proceso continuo de transformación y mejora.

· Gran ambiente laboral

· Oportunidad de crecimiento, desarrollo profesional y de liderar proyectos

Requiere un Desarrollador .NET con los conocimientos que se detallan a continuación:

- Ingeniero informático o FP Superior Desarrollo Aplicaciones Web/Multiplataforma.

- Dominio de Microsoft .NET

- Conocimiento de SQL server

- MySQL / MariaDB

- Conocimiento en GIT

- Más de 4 años de experiencia ( demostrable )

Otros requisitos importantes:

- Conocimientos en desarrollo de aplicaciones Android.

- Participación en proyectos grupales o de colaboración.

- Realización de labor analítica en proyectos.

SE OFRECE:

- Flexibilidad laboral.

- Salario entre 30 y... 40, en función de la experiencia demostrable.

- Beneficios sociales.

- Bonus por objetivos.
• Si te apasiona el mundo de la programación y crees que tu perfil se adapta a la oferta ¡queremos conocerte

jobs_results.title: .NET Developer proyecto internacional Remoto 100%
jobs_results.description:
Desde Oxigent Technologies, seleccionamos un/a .NET DEVELOPER para incorporarse a un equipo de desarrollo de soluciones a medida para sector defensa, ubicado en Madrid ciudad o con posibilidad de remoto.

Tu misión principal será participar en el desarrollo de nuevas funcionalidades y productos de la empresa, dentro de un entorno completamente Ágil trabajando con ASP.NET MVC o ASP.NET Core.

Trabajando en entornos Cloud, y con Docker/kubernetes). Desarrollarás aplicaciones con grandes volúmenes de datos.

Para ello, será necesario tener experiencia con:
• 4 años de experiencia como desarrollador/a de productos web y APIs.
• ASP.NET MVC o ASP.NET Core
• Tener formación en Ingeniería Informática o Ingeniería de Software.
• Se valora familiaridad con las tecnologías front-end (HTML, CSS, JavaScript).
• Sólidos conocimientos de bases de datos relacionales y SQL.
• Experiencia con desarrollo e integración de API RESTful.
• Conocimiento de sistemas de control de versiones, como Git.
•... Familiaridad con tecnologías de contenedorización (Docker, Kubernetes).

Y llegados a este punto... ¿qué te ofrecemos?
• Contratación indefinida.
• Salario acorde a la experiencia aportada (entre 40.000 - 45.000 euros brutos anuales).
• Horario flexible y jornada intensiva los viernes.
• Modelo híbrido o posibilidad de remoto.
• Cheque Formación para desarrollarte en las áreas profesionales que más te interesen.
• Seguro médico privado.
• Retribución flexible aplicable a seguro médico, restaurante, transporte, guardería y formación.
• Aplicación de acceso a gimnasios y actividades deportivas en toda España con descuentos.

¡Y muchos otros beneficios

jobs_results.description:
¡Capitole sigue creciendo y queremos hacerlo contigo!

📌 ¿De qué proyecto se trata?

Estamos buscando un programador FullStack (Vue & Python) con +3 años de experiencia para una cliente TOP de Capitole en el que se busca ampliar el equipo para el desarrollo de nuevas funcionalidades del aplicativo.

📣 Además de este, contamos con otros proyectos que podrían interesarte! 🙃

• Vue 3
• Sql Server y ORMs: EF y Dapper
• Typescript
• Testing (XUnit o similar)

• Metodologías Ágiles

🧐 ¿Qué ofrecemos?

▪ Banda salarial en función de experiencia. 💰

▪ Presupuesto de formación anual de 1200€ 📚 ( cursos , certificaciones , eventos...)

▪ Horario flexible, para ayudarte a conciliar tu vida profesional ... familiar. 👨👨👧👧

▪ Teletrabajo 100%. 🏠💻

▪ Team building todos los meses 🚀 ( Cena navidad , Pool Party , Bolos , eventos...)

▪ Gympass , actividades deportivas y hasta equipo de futbol¡¡⚽️

▪ Seguro médico privado pagado por Capitole. 👨⚕️

▪ ¡Por último y no menos importante un EQUIPAZO!

Somos geniales, pero contigo lo seremos más 😊

We value different perspectives and the experience of each and every employee. We treat each other as equals, are open with each other and have a culture of trust. Innovation and progress are important to us in order to cope with constant change and future challenges. To do this, we need strong personalities. Become part of SDK and help us continue our success story! jobs_results.title: Beca Ingeniero de software Front / Back
jobs_results.description:
En SlashMobility estamos buscando un/a Ingeniero de Software para incorporarse en nuestra área de proyectos. Buscamos a alguien que disfrute desarrollando e impulsando nuevos proyectos y con ganas de asumir un nuevo reto.

¿Quiénes Somos?

Somos una empresa de Soluciones Mobile Corporate, cuya misión está centrada en acelerar la digitalización tecnológica de la sociedad mediante servicios Mobile 360º. Desde 2010 nos hemos convertido en una empresa referente en el mercado mediante el desarrollo software, formación y captación de talento digital, en este tiempo ha sido el lugar donde más de 70 personas han hecho realidad más de 1000 proyectos para 150 clientes con presencia nacional e internacional como FC.Barcelona, Inditex, UFV, etc.

¿En qué creemos?

Innovación, ofreciendo soluciones innovadoras de una manera profesional y rentable con un valor diferencial: el conocimiento experto en toda la cadena de valor.

Compromiso ya que llevamos como propios los objetivos de la organización y... superamos cualquier obstáculo para lograrlos.

Proactividad, proveyendo y realizando acciones para mejorar sus servicios y calidad.

Trabajo en equipo, contando con un equipo motivado y multidisciplinar que trabaja en perfecta coordinación para lograr los objetivos comunes.

Respecto al proyecto;

Participarás en proyectos para diferentes clientes y con diferente alcance. ¡Apostamos a qué no te aburrirás!

Aprenderás y te familiarizarás con metodologías ágiles (Agile, Scrum y JIRA).

Estarás en un equipo que valora las ideas y propuestas de los otros. En búsqueda de constante mejora.

Llegarás a diseñar vistas con auto layouts.

Podrás estimar proyectos, hacer auditorías de aplicaciones, aprender a gestionar bugs y errores.

Colaborarás con diferentes compañeros en función del proyecto, conocerás la metodología squads.

Tendrás a disposición diferentes opciones para formarte y seguir creciendo como profesional.

Requisitos:

Posibilidad de firmar convenio en prácticas con la universidad

jobs_results.description: ADO.NET, Model-View-Controller, Microsoft Windows, Frontend, SQL, ASP.NET, IT, JavaScript, Angular, T-SQL, Anwendungsentwicklung, Relationale Datenbanken, Softwareentwicklung, Application Programming Interfaces, Backend, Datenbanken, C#, TCP/IP, Implementierung, Entity Framework, SAP, Microsoft SQL Server, Scrum, Windows Presentation Foundation, .NET (Senior) Software Developer - Full-Stack (m/f/d) Skills Full-Stack frontend backend Software development development C# .NET ASP.NET Angular MVC Web API WebForms WinForms WPF JavaScript SQL Relational database RDBMS ADO.NET Entity Framework EF T-SQL Windows Salary band 60,000 - 85,000 EUR About your LPA team We are a leading global developer, provider and advisor of technology-based capital market solutions for banks, insurance companies and fund providers. Become a part of our vision and dive into the world of technology and innovation in the financial sector! Our award-winning products and services help our clients to automate and... digitize regulatory required documentation and reporting processes, minimize risks and thus increase their efficiency with full compliance. As a passionate full-stack developer (m/f/d) with experience in the Windows world, you will work, sometimes remotely, together with our experts at the Frankfurt office both on the development of new applications and on the further development of existing software solutions. Your tasks Development of innovative applications, from prototyping to implementation of new products Further development of our software products for the capital market business Analyzing complex requirements and developing solutions in collaboration with highly motivated colleagues within and outside our cross-functional Scrum teams Evaluating and introducing new technologies and concepts Clarification of technical issues and creation of IT concepts - with and for our customers In addition to this product-centered work, you will work in a team to continuously improve and automate development and deployment processes. Your entry ticket You have several years of professional experience in application development - at least 10 years, ideally even 15 years Your experience is characterized by leading roles in the design of system subcomponents as well as in the migration and optimization of legacy systems You have extensive experience in the practical application of C#, .NET, ASP.NET, MVC & Web API, Angular, Web and Win Forms, WPF, JavaScript - preferably in agile projects - with A good understanding of databases - e.g. SQL Server RDBMS, ADO. NET & Entity Framework, T-SQL, etc. - is a given for you You are familiar with the principles relevant to the development of distributed software systems You are familiar with the development of rich and web clients, the design of larger data models and know how to design interfaces for integration A very good understanding of the basics of computer architectures, network topologies and protocols such as TCP/IP and HTTP complete your profile Experience in large customer projects is desirable - e.g. with 3rd party systems such as Calypso, Murex, SAP, including customer support and escalation Our features Software meets consulting: an established and growing company with start-up flair and flat hierarchies right up to the executive level A flexible working time model (including the option to work mobile 3 days a week) and workation A team-oriented, humorous working environment that is characterized by cohesion and offers you exciting tasks every day An office in the heart of Frankfurt with excellent public transport connections A wide range of further training opportunities Regular employee events and a flat rate of coffee, soft drinks and fruit Your contact person We look forward to receiving your application, which you should send to ******! If you have any questions, please contact Christian Baum on +49 69 9714850. We value diversity and therefore welcome all applications - regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic and social background, religion/belief, disability, age, sexual orientation and identity

jobs_results.title: Backend Developer
jobs_results.description: Keyfactor is one of the world's leading companies for Machine Identity, Certificate Lifecycle Management and Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) Solutions. We help security teams manage cryptography as critical infrastructure by simplifying PKI including Certificate Issuance, Certificate Life Cycle Management, and Secure Code Signing.This position will work as a core member of our software development team in Barcelona Spain working on Keyfactor Signum, one of our Code Signing products. jobs_results.title: Software Developer (.NET)
jobs_results.description:
About us :

As the European market leader, NEXTLANE develops and delivers digital solutions for the automotive industry by connecting the systems of manufacturers and dealers.

We develop integrated end-to-end software and digital solutions that digitize and simplify the entire automotive customer journey.

Our mission is to empower our clients to boost their business operations and optimize their customer experience through innovative solutions. Our comprehensive software suite revolutionizes every aspect of new and used vehicle sales and management.

📋 Context of the Position :

Nextlane needs a .NET developer, which will be responsible for the evolution, development and maintenance of a CRM product for the automotive sector (for vehicle sales), whose users are all located in Sweden.

They will report to the IT Project Manager. The team will be composed by 4 developers, 1 technical leader and 1 functional tester.

🎯 Your responsibilities :

As a key member of our team, you'll be... responsible for :

Main missions
• Make the technical implementation of the functional requirements, proposing optimized technical solutions.
• Write technical documentation: how the process are implemented, databases tables, diagrams, swaggers, etc.
• Develop, evolution and maintenance of the CRM.
• Guide the team in the resolution of day-to-day technical problems.
• Review the commits and technical documentation of the other teammates.
• Deployment of versions.
• Communicate with Project Manager and Technical Leader on a frequent basis.

Main interfaces with other teams / departments
• Product team: to assist in the technical analysis of functional proposals and their feasibility.
• Support team to coordinate the resolution of complex incidents.

🕵️ What we are looking for :

Technical Skills
• +2 years of programming experience in the technologies involved.
• Have worked with agile methodologies.
• Expert in the main technologies:
• C# .Net,, PostgreSQL (Ability to develop advanced and complex solutions in these technologies in an optimal way).
• HTML5
• REST, Web Services, SOAP, JSON, XML.
• Input and output files: CSV, XML, Excel, PDF generation.
• Clean code work is highly valued

Soft skills
• To be very careful with the quality of the work
• Partnership

Languages
• Fluent English

🤝 Our Recruitment Process:

1. 30-minute call with our Talent Acquisition Specialist.

2. Technical test.

3. Technical discussion to validate your technical skills. You will also meet with your Project Manager to discuss the project and have the opportunity to resolve any questions or concerns you may have.

Join us and be part of the Nextlane adventure that is shaping the future of the automotive industry!

💎 Our Advantages

We value flexibility and trust within our corporate culture, offering benefits that reflect our commitment to our teams:

🏡 Possibility to telework up to 3 days a week!

🤝 €600 referral bonus for each talent you capture. (after the 6-month tiral period).

🍱 Flexible Remuneration (COBEE).

👩 ⚕️ Medical Insurance (Adeslas).

📒 Access to a dedicated internal training platform for continuous learning.

🌴 23 days of vacation. Intensive day July and August.

🤝 Diversity, Equity, Inclusion & Belonging:

We are committed to enabling everyone to feel included and valued in the workplace. We believe that the company and its culture are strongest when they are made up of diverse experiences and backgrounds.

We welcome applications from people with disabilities. If you are a person with a disability and need help, please let us know so we can talk about how we can best support and make any adjustments that may be necessary.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of age, color, family, gender identity, marital status, national origin, physical or mental disability, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws.

🌍 What does it mean to work at Nextlane?

Join a young and fast-growing company, where you can work on new and ambitious projects.

International and multicultural environment.

Collaboration between colleagues.

We truly believe that Nextlane is a great place to work and develop your talent! Sign up for our offer and find out why
